basic_info.description: Welcome to 2062 20th Ave, a masterfully remodeled Sunset dream home featuring 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and 2,285 sqft of luxurious living space. This rare gem offers an ideal layout with 2 bedrooms and 2 baths on the top floor and an additional 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, and a spacious family room on the lower level perfect for comfortable and flexible living.  Every detail of this home exudes elegance, from the gorgeous white oak wood floors and recessed lighting to the natural light that fills each room. The open kitchen showcases beautiful cabinetry, brand new Milgard windows, and a seamless flow for effortless entertaining. Remodeled bathrooms feature high end finishes, while new systems which include electrical, insulation, plumbing, and furnace offer peace of mind for years to come.  Located near Sunset's shops and restaurants, top-rated schools, public transportation, Golden Gate Park, and Ocean Beach, this home offers the best of San Francisco living in an unbeatable neighborhood.
